description: Source register: line-referenced claims extracted from R01-R03, consolidated into world nodes, with source-fidelity checks (all three parts). Claims record what a report says, not verified fact.

fidelity.verdict: The register is faithful to the reports overall. I checked all 88 source_claims entries in the 23 nodes against the cited lines (186 claim, platform, quantity and relationship strings in total). I found no wrong line numbers, no altered numbers (12,000 acres; 4,000-6,000 acres; 75/134/11; 4,500; 250; 3,800/4,700 km; 8 billion NOK; five P-8A; six fatalities; five JLSCs) and no wrong operators or places in the claim texts. No populate_policy contradicts the plan. Ban Keun is a research lead marked do_not_populate (plan:44). Kitsap and Longpo record strategic submarine basing as a bare fact, the Kitsap nuclear-weapons-facility sentence is excluded, and the Longpo pen layout is not modelled. Whiting, the DLA centres, Anniston and the JLSF nodes are abstract only (plan:33, plan:36). Deveselu is context_only (plan:24, plan:41). The 16 problems found are low to moderate. (1) The Kitsap 'critical node' clause takes its wording from the excluded nuclear-weapons-facility sentence. (2) Kitsap treats Bremerton and PSNS as one site, which no report states. (3) Several fields add unstated detail: 'US' at Muharraq, the Deveselu operator and '(interior)', the Ukrainka operator, and 'same island' at Sigonella. (4) The Andersen overlap note credits R01:23's 'aviation hub' wording to Guam when R01 gives it to Naval Base Guam, and 'aviation half' is a plan:34 design choice, not an R03 statement. (5) The Reagan-to-Kitsap link cites R03:38 when it needs R03:62. (6) Relationships (Newport News, the Guam tandem, the APF fleet, NB San Diego) are filed under parent_or_colocated. (7) The Diego Garcia populate_reason could be read as putting every MPS hull in one anchorage. The outside-knowledge check_notes I spot-checked are reasonable. My great-circle estimates put Diego Garcia about 6,920 km from Beijing and about 3,840 km from Chabahar on Iran's south coast, which supports that note. Housekeeping: the checked-out branch is sest-dev/sweet-lovelace-3kxsve, not feature/world-campaign-draft. I computed the reports' SHA-256 values (R01 ad8e8260..., R02 293c7aaa..., R03 44bc8e02...) but could not compare them because no expected digests were supplied. R03 has 172 lines and line 172 resolves correctly. No repository files were modified.

fidelity.verdict: Mostly faithful, but fixes are needed before Pass B. I checked all 77 source_claims plus 84 platform, quantity and relationship strings against R01-R03 by line. Every source_claims line number points to the right sentence, and the numbers, operators and places match the reports. That includes 57,000 acres, 3,800 acres, over 100 aircraft, four Typhoon FGR4, 2,589 m, up to 35 Tu-22M3 and 10 Tu-95MS, up to 42 Tu-22M3, 92 km, 4,500 km, $590 million, 34-36 P-1 and four Triomphant-class. Populate policies match the plan. Ile Longue is context_only with no nuclear-storage or handling detail extracted (the Fusiliers Marins perimeter-defence point is conventional force protection). Ban Keun is not in this part. Red River, San Joaquin, the DLA centres and the APF are abstract. Mount Pleasant is small. There are no medium or high factual errors. There are two medium structural issues: the Wuxi-to-Ningbo pairing in parent_or_colocated, and the PSNS / Naval Station Bremerton merge, which the reports do not make. There is one misattributed citation (R03:133 for Lingshui), which also undercuts the 'service not stated' check note. The rest is low-severity drift: R02:17 is read as asserting DLA colocation at PSNS and Jacksonville; the R02:71 'alongside' is changed to 'and'; the R02:67 referent is changed; parent_or_colocated is misused for Newport News and the APF; and two plan citations are off (plan:81, plan:43). Several place-specific lines are uncited, notably R02:33 for the APF, R03:72 for Olenya's standoff sorties, R01:17 and R03:29 for the Kitsap drydock and CVN maintenance, and R02:17 for San Joaquin.
